create_ema: create an exponential moving average updater with a given decay rate and optional pmean axis name
test_ema_moments: test that the EMA updater correctly computes debiased mean and variance moments over a sequence of values
build_ema_state: build an EMA state from a template tree with zeroed mu, nu, and initial decay product
test_ema_debiased_moments: test that EmaState.debiased_moments returns correct mean and variance estimates using Adam-style debiasing
review_ema_moments_dataclass: review the EmaMoments dataclass that holds the latest mean and variance estimates
